steps.title: Test the exact candidate through G1-G9
steps.request_template: Inspect ${proposal.title} at its exact candidate identity and produce one moonsuite.engineering-evidence-draft.v1 containing R1-R3 and G1-G9. Use pure MoonBit plus bounded shell commands, never Python. Use the same receipts for progress, health, production quality, and release rehearsal. Do not edit, review, or publish the repository.

steps.title: Independently review evidence
steps.request_template: In a separate MoonClaw task, independently review the G1-G9 producer draft for ${proposal.title}. Verify candidate identity and task separation, rerun a bounded risk-weighted sample with MoonBit plus shell only, reject unsupported receipts, and write the single reviewed moonsuite.engineering-evidence.v2 ledger.

steps.title: Prepare MoonProj projection
steps.prompt_template: Return the independently reviewed moonsuite.engineering-evidence.v2 ledger for ${proposal.title}. MoonProj derives progress, health, and production projections; do not add scores or publication authority.

steps.title: Collect unified G1-G9 evidence
steps.prompt_template: Use the MoonSuite production Gate skill for ${request}. Produce one candidate-bound draft with bounded MoonBit and shell evidence only; do not emit separate progress, health, production, or review artifacts.

steps.title: Review audit evidence
steps.prompt_template: Use the MoonSuite evidence review skill for ${request}. You must run as a different MoonClaw task from every evidence producer and use bounded MoonBit plus shell evidence only.
